svg.title: A 1 × 2 matrix is a vector lying on its side
svg.desc: The plane with lines of equal value for the rule 3x + 4y. A number line runs along the vector (3, 4); î lands on 3, ĵ on 4 and (4, 2) on 20, exactly the dot products with (3, 4).

g.text: the rule [3 4] turns each arrow into a number
dashed lines: every point on one of them
the number line runs along (3, 4); each number
is a shadow on it times the length 5
